contract.automatic_credit_clause: §4: credits are issued automatically against the next invoice
contract.exclusive_remedy_clause: §4.5: service credits are the sole and exclusive remedy, subject to stated exceptions
contract.report_cutoff: within 10 business days after month close
contract.credit_cap: 100% of Monthly Service Fee per Service Period
contract.idempotency: one ledger row and one stable Stripe Idempotency-Key per tenant and UTC service month
contract.safety_gate: SLA_CREDITS_ENABLED=true is required by both the sweep and provider; production wrangler value is false

invariants: No observation is published before a closed UTC month and the ten-business-day report cutoff.
A tenant and service month can create at most one credit and one idempotency key.
A provider call is impossible while the explicit credits gate is disabled or no provider credential is supplied.
Crash recovery reuses the durable outbox body and idempotency key; a changed billing mapping is blocked or retried for review.
Provider acceptance is not treated as proof until the provider object is reconciled against the request and recorded in D1.

repository_observation.remaining_repo_verification: none identified for the implemented contract path

external_receipts_required.action: apply migration 0117 to the production BILLING_DB binding
enable the gate only for a controlled test tenant and execute one credit mutation
replay the same sweep and show one provider object for the stable idempotency key

external_receipts_required.artifact: provider reconciliation and D1 audit export
external_receipts_required.action: match the provider object to the next invoice and retain ledger, outbox, reconciliation, and audit rows

contract_decisions_pending: The executed SLA defines Free, Starter, Pro, and Enterprise, while the published product ladder also sells Solo and Max; those tiers have no corresponding executed SLA tier.
The published Terms grant Pro an automatic credit, while apps/docs/src/lib/pricing.ts marks Pro slaCredits=false and its test expects only Enterprise to have credits.
Owner and counsel must decide whether to amend the signed instrument and align published pricing/Terms before enabling credits.
prohibited: issuing credits or calling Stripe from this repository-only artifact
editing or replacing the signed/effective SLA or other legal instrument
inventing provider, invoice, migration, or reconciliation evidence
storing credentials, routing keys, or provider responses in git
closure_rule: Close only after the legal/commercial decision is recorded and the owner supplies the four provider-backed receipts; repository text alone cannot prove a live credit or invoice.
